jobs_results.title: Social Media Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
VIKO es una Digital-Business Factory especializada en conectar oportunidades digitales desde 1999. ¿Cómo lo hacemos? Uniendo ideas, personas y recursos para lograr una única misión: crear valor con valores.

Este holding, actualmente, está formado por:

⚡Elogia (agencia de marketing digital), ⚡Marketing4eCommerce (medio de comunicación online especializado en el ecosistema digital), ⚡M4C Academy (formación online), ⚡Tandem Up (consultoría especializada en Marketplaces), ⚡Kraz (consultoría de analítica avanzada), ⚡Kaibos (Amazon brand builder),⚡Candee (consultora de talento Candidate First especializada en talento digital) y⚡Optopus (agencia especializada en soluciones avanzadas para optimizar el punto de venta digital).

Contaba Oriol Chías, nuestro CTO, y nuestro Digital Warrior número 0, que VIKO nació porque un grupo de personas que se entendían y que se lo pasaban bien querían trabajar juntas. Ahí se sembró una cultura Employee First que nos ha acompañado hasta hoy.

Ahora en VIKO... contamos con más de 20 años de trayectoria, oficinas en España y México, y un equipo de más de 200 talentos que hacen posible todo esto, de los cuales 23 llevan más de 10 años trabajando juntxs, y 25 se fueron un día para volver a casa un tiempo después.

Si quieres ayudarnos a seguir escribiendo nuestra historia y quieres formar parte de ella… Esta puede ser tu oportunidad, y ¡estás a un click de hacerlo posible! 😎

📌 Estamos buscando a una persona que quiera formar parte de Elogia como Social Media Project Manager.

¿Cuál será tu misión? 🚀

Tu misión como Social Media Project Manager será la de ayudar a nuestros clientes a conseguir los mejores resultados de la mano de un equipo altamente especializado y que lleva la innovación en el ADN.

¿Cómo es el equipo con el que trabajarás? 💁

Formarás parte de una Dirección de Servicios a Cliente, donde te rodearás de profesionales que se vuelcan en enamorar a su cliente. Estas personas tienen conocimiento especializado en distintas áreas especializadas del marketing digital: Market Intelligence, SEO, UX, Analítica, Marketing Automation, Social & Content MK y Paid Media.

¿Y cómo lo harás? 📅
• Crearás estrategias de campañas teniendo conocimiento de las particularidades de cada red social y tipos de usuarios (Buyer Persona), definiendo los objetivos y sus correspondientes KPIS, identificando los territorios y pilares de comunicación más adecuados y marcando la periodicidad de publicación idónea para cada canal propuesto.
• Gestionarás al cliente, acompañándole en el desarrollo del proyecto y en el análisis de los resultados.
• Elaborarás propuestas de apertura de nuevos canales, de nuevos objetivos en los mismos canales, propuestas de promoción o con objetivo disruptivo, y las presentarás y gestionarás junto al equipo con el cliente.
• Gestionarás campañas con influenciadores online, identificando los perfiles más adecuados para cada campaña, negociando con ellos y haciendo seguimiento de las acciones contratadas.
• Trabajarás con campañas de Paid Social, para las que definirás los canales y los objetivos, y para las que te encargarás de activar, seguir y analizar los promoted posts.
• Realizarás el seguimiento y la coordinación de campañas mediante la realización de informes; para ello, es importante que tengas capacidad analítica.
• Formarás parte del HUB Social Media de Elogia, gestionando la presencia del cliente en los medios sociales y colaborando en la implementación y búsqueda de innovación en el área, desarrollando tareas de innovación en el HUB.

Antes de seguir, ¡queremos que conozcas nuestro secreto! ¿Por qué nuestrxs Digital Warriors se sienten como en casa? 🏠 Mejor no te lo contamos nosotrxs, ¡esto es todo lo que dicen ellxs!

💗 Por las personas y por el buen ambiente que se respira. Nos gusta lo que hacemos, nos ayudamos los unxs a los otrxs, nos divertimos, y hacemos de cada día una aventura.

⏰ Por la flexibilidad y la conciliación para que haya un equilibrio trabajo-vida personal.

🪁 Por la confianza que se tiene en cada persona, dando la libertad, el empoderamiento y la responsabilidad de liderar proyectos y llevarlos al éxito, siempre bajo la filosofía “Learning by doing”.

📈 Por los proyectos retadores y el aprendizaje continuo de la mano de clientes top (Hero, Platanomelón, Tous..), y de las personas expertas de la casa.

🎯 Por el crecimiento profesional y el acompañamiento gracias a las sesiones de Mentoring, que nos ayudan a lograr nuestras metas y a hacer brillar nuestras habilidades. Evitamos las “típicas” evaluaciones de desempeño.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?🎉
• Formar parte de un equipo altamente especializado en un entorno joven, dinámico y flexible.
• Horario flexible de entrada y de salida.
• Jornada intensiva todos los viernes, y los meses de julio y agosto.
• 23 días de vacaciones + 3 (el 24 y el 31 de diciembre y el día de tu cumpleaños, ¡te los regalamos!)
• Formato de asistencia híbrido: Pedimos una asistencia mínima a la oficina de dos días por semana (entre martes y jueves). No obstante, las oficinas están abiertas de lunes a viernes para que puedan ser utilizadas. La asistencia será opcional durante los períodos de Semana Santa, mes de Agosto, semana del 6-8 de diciembre (en ciertos casos) y semanas de Navidad y Reyes.
• Oficinas en Barcelona, Madrid, Vigo, A Coruña y CDMX.
• Descuentos exclusivos en marcas como PlatanoMelon, Hero, Surippa, entre otras.
• Plan de retribución flexible con Cobee (restaurantes y transportes), o a través de otros proveedores (seguro de salud y guardería) para que puedas disfrutar de beneficios fiscales.
• Beca completa para formación en Marketing4eCommerce Academy: tendrás acceso gratuito a nuestro campus.
• Apoyo económico para estudiar inglés.
• Recursos relacionados con el desarrollo personal y apoyo psicológico 24/7 a través de Mindgram.
• Actividades de equipo organizadas por la Comisión de Fiestas #WeAreFun

jobs_results.title: Offshore Wind Project Manager - Foundations and Floaters
jobs_results.description:
Owing to continued growth and high demand for our services, we are looking for an Offshore Wind Project Manager, specialised in foundations and floating platforms design, to join our global energy team in one of our offices in Europe.
Whilst specialised in foundations and floating platforms design, as Project Manager you will also lead the delivery of offshore wind consultancy projects (owner’s engineering, due diligences and lender’s technical advisory, mainly) for clients worldwide and ensure they are delivered on time, on budget and with zero errors. This includes coordination of internal MM, and external resource where needed, deliverable review and acceptance, budget and time adherence, client liaison, and internal reporting on offshore wind projects. The role will also involve the preparation of bids for new work.
In summary, as an offshore wind professional within Mott MacDonald, ideally but not necessarily focused on foundation/platforms only, you will provide technical... support to a wide variety of stakeholders including developers, original equipment manufacturers, regulators and financing.

Candidate Specification :
Essential:
• Working knowledge of offshore structural engineering, including comprehension of the sea environment and hydrodynamic loads, both at temporary and operational stages.
• Deep understanding of the different foundation typologies for both bottom-fixed and floating, as well as the key drivers for the concept selection of each design solution.
• Awareness of the interfaces between turbine and foundation/platform, including key understanding of load iteration and integrated load analysis for offshore wind.
• Knowledge of the relevant Offshore Wind design codes and certification requirements, from DNV, IEC, ABS and other international standards.
• First-hand knowledge of offshore structural analysis software like SACS, SESAM, DEEPLINES or similar, to perform structural design and verifications.
• Familiarity with CAD or other modelling software
• Command on naval basic concepts (stability, masses, etc.)

Desirable:
• Demonstrable experience of project management of offshore wind projects or packages.
• Excellent IT skills particularly MS Excel/Word/Project and PowerPoint.
• Self-motivation, ability to use own initiative, flexible, problem solving approach.
• Experience of working within a multi-disciplinary engineering environment.
• Ability to communicate clearly & concisely in English, both verbally & written and ability to explain technical issues to non-engineers, including Clients.
• Ability to produce and review technical reports for clients, so attention to detail is paramount.
• Ability to lead/chair and present at meetings etc.

We are actively recruiting a diverse workforce that is reflective of the communities we serve. We recognise that differences in ability, skills and experience are a strength and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.

Mott MacDonald

We’re a global engineering, management, and development consultancy.
Our purpose is to improve society by considering social outcomes in everything we do, relentlessly focusing on excellence and digital innovation, transforming our clients’ businesses, our communities and employee opportunities.

A fundamental part of this is respecting each person’s differences and striving to meet their needs.

Our values: Progress, Respect, Integrity, Drive, Excellence.

Equality, diversity, and inclusion

We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels they can contribute.

Accessibility

We want you to perform your best at every stage in the recruitment process. If you are disabled or need any support to enable you to apply or attend an interview, please contact us at reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com and we will talk to you about how we can support you.

Agile working

Happy to talk Flexible Working and how we can support your responsibilities beyond the workplace.

We offer some fantastic benefits including:
• Life insurance 
• An annual professional institution subscription  
• Continuous development opportunities – because we want you to thrive 
• Agile/flexible working – because life isn’t 9-5 
• Enhanced parental leave
• Annual bonus scheme
• Flexible benefits that suit you, including ability to buy/sell annual leave entitlement, cycle to work & interest free season ticket loans
• Wellbeing support including access to an independent Employer Assistance Scheme, wellbeing champions and access to learning and support resources
• Access to our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability and parents/carers communities
• The opportunity to make a difference; learn more about our social outcomes

Apply now, or for more information about our application process, click here

jobs_results.title: Corporate Social Responsibility - Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Verisure is Europe's fastest-growing monitored security company and continues to strengthen its presence in South America. This rapid expansion and ongoing success is expected to continue. As a result, Verisure is reinforcing its new ESG team with an exciting, rewarding, and impactful position to support its ambitious growth plan.

Verisure is seeking a talented CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) Project Manager to join the team. This role provides an outstanding platform for a highly motivated individual to work with our Group ESG department, whilst providing strong visibility with key leaders in the company. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a transformational growth story. Critical and strategic, the role will be instrumental in advancing the company’s ESG agenda, shaping the CSR strategy and rolling it out at a global level. We are looking for someone who can make a tangible positive impact to transform and add value to our communities, not only to our Company but to... the industry itself.

The company’s success depends on its people and it invests in them every day. Working with Verisure is being part of an industry leading world-class company that has a strong entrepreneurial spirit.

Strategic context and Value proposition

Verisure has been actively pursuing increased focus and leadership on social and environmental issues to drive both business and societal value. This position will be part of a dedicated ESG core team, that will be delivering a new global CSR strategy and approach, designed to enhance business performance and shareholder value, energize employees, support our brand, and ultimately bring positive societal value and impact to Verisure communities and beyond.

The role will manage the development and implementation of our CSR strategy across Verisure different geographies. This role will strength of our ESG Roadmap through our new CSR strategy and its execution and roll out across different functions and in our markets. It will also oversee the establishment of data and content collection and validation processes for various stakeholder groups.

Responsibilities will include:
• Lead the development and execution of Verisure’s CSR strategy, CSR policy and it’s action plan
• Establishing data-driven CSR goals, milestones and metrics, and developing the analytical tools needed to evaluate and measure CSR efforts
• Leading the roll-out and building consensus for the action plan amongst key stakeholders in different countries within leadership teams.
• Developing and implementing a company-wide plan for collecting, storing, validating and distributing CSR data and content for reporting; adding value by responding to key stakeholders' requests
• Shaping CSR messages within the concept of strategy and long-term value creation for Verisure
• Lead on the development, planning and execution of CSR roadmap, including key actions and processes; (corporate volunteering, fundraising, donations, partnerships, thought leadership actions, etc.)

Reporting line and location

This role will report to our Head of Group DEIB. The position is a based in Pozuelo de Alarcón (Spain's HQ - Madrid).

Candidate profile

Experience and requirements

We are looking for a high potential, proactive and solution-oriented individual focused on driving value to the business who is looking for a challenging yet rewarding job. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to learn from Group HR, Group Finance, and other high-performing teams transversally
• 2 years of experience in designing, monitoring and managing CSR programs across different categories and relevant stakeholders, at a global scale. Experience in a strategy or management consulting role (pre-/post-MBA, depending on the overall experience) will be highly valued.
• Experience in interacting with key stakeholders internally and externally to obtain the buy-in for CSR objectives and initiatives
• Valuable experience in program/project management with evidence of working in a strategic and advisory capacity – strong consulting mindset and business partnering approach
• Experience in some of CSR main topics would also be required: Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging (DEIB), community engagement and impact, employee well-being, social innovation, education initiatives, social/humanitarian crisis response
• Problem structuring, strategic problem-solving and very strong analytical skills, coupled with strong Excel skills
• Required: fluent in written and spoken English and Spanish. Other European languages are a plus.

We are Bring IT!

We are a fast growing, young and dynamic professional services company bringing digital transformation to our customers around the world. From taking products to the market, to boosting productivity with the right technology and processes, the work we do is improving the way people work. To get there, we’re building a global and diverse team that can tackle some of the most challenging problems of our time. We name this unique approach “360 success”.

We are recognized as one of the fastest growing and successful companies on the INC5000 ranking in the USA, and we are opening new offices around the world to further grow, explore and diversify. With over 10 recognitions from our partners, we continue to win in our markets.

Join our Dream Team

The Bring IT team has over 150 people spread across many countries around the world. We understand that great technology begins with great talent and diversity of... thought.

Our business is being built on friendship, teamwork and a passion for what we do. This is shaping our culture every day and we’re looking for great talent that want to make an impact in the world.

You can have a rewarding career at Bring IT as we are committed to seeing you grow both professionally and personally.

Community Impact

We are invested in making a positive impact for all people on our planet. That’s why we connect our objectives to the United Nations sustainable goals, especially in clean energy, health & wellbeing and infrastructure. Moving forward we will start supporting special sustainability programs and perhaps you want to be part of that.

Discover your new role

As a Netsuite Project Manager for our implementations team, you will lead a group of consultants throughout all stages of the implementation’s lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in project management life cycle, experience working with SuiteSuccess methodology and a problem-solving mindset.

Your Day-to-Day

• Lead project management activities such as project planning, creation of work breakdown structures, and change management control
• Manage scope throughout all phases of the project life cycle. Maintains accurate program estimates, timelines, project plans, and status reports. Ensure achievement of project milestones.

• Act as lead communicator to internal and external stakeholders regarding expectations, resolutions, and prioritization. Ability to interact professionally with a diverse group of developers, product owners, and subject matter experts.
• Learns from project retrospective and applies the learning for future projects.

Do you have what it takes?

Get ready to build your 360 success.

Must-have
• 5+ years of experience in project management
• 2+ years of proven experience in delivering full-cycle ERP implementation projects
• Experience in NetSuite ERP implementations
• Exprience in Professional Services and SaaS
• Full English Professional Fluency
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Desired Skills & Qualifications:
• Suite Success methodology experience
• PMP certification is a plus
• Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills needed to be effective in a fast-paced high-energy company.
• Display initiative, self-motivation and deliver high-quality work while at the same time, meeting all deadlines for both internal and external customers

Still not convinced you should apply?

In Bring IT we want to make a difference:
• We provide best-in-class services on Oracle NetSuite, top services provider for Zendesk, Celigo, Boomi and other business cloud applications.
• We take our talent’s wellbeing very seriously with a dedicated program called Bring IT is You
• We value our Talent and provide learning and development opportunities for everyone
• We are a winning Company with a agile and innovative mindset.

Our Values and Culture

This year we have chosen teamwork as our value in focus. We believe with real teamwork we achieve business excellence and creativity for our customers. Working together, growing together. Our culture influences the way we interact, the context within which knowledge is created, the way we embrace change, and ultimately the way we share knowledge. We offer exceptional career growth and learning opportunities to our employees with skill development workshops, mentoring programs, and support for side projects and entrepreneurial work.

Our Benefits and Perks

We offer competitive compensation and unique personal benefits, including industry-leading maternity and paternity leave, training programs, social hours, our wellness Friday´s and remote work opportunities. All team members have access to continuous learning opportunities including cloud certifications, mentorship and in-house leadership skills sessions developed by our experts in the field. Our development plan architect is waiting for you to design your personal plan.

Our Global Family

To support the global nature of our business and help our employees grow beyond their technical skills, we offer free virtual English language classes as well as provide immigration support when applicable. We are member of the Minority Business Enterprise, supporting their programs for minority businesses in the USA.

#BRINGIT=YOU

We create and foster a diverse, inclusive, and harassment-free workplace where everyone can achieve their full potential. All applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

Please note that by submitting your application, you agree with the terms and conditions of our Privacy Policy

jobs_results.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 74,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time Project Manager - REPAIR & OVERHAULS in Madrid we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your management expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside young and proactive teammates.

You'll be accountable for project QCDP and project EHS. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (repairs & overhaul), ensure Alstom legal and contractual rights are protected and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of driving the execution of project, according to contractual requirements and customer... expectations (summarized in contract charter), to maximize the results with respect to cash and margin whilst delivering on time, in conformity with Alstom project management and execution processes, but also seek and propose to the Parts & Overhaul Project Coordinator Manager/ Platform additional opportunities.

We’ll look to you for:
• Be accountable for project QCDP performance and optimize Project Financial performance (Margin & Cash). As WP Owner of the Project Management Work Package, he/she is QCDP accountable for all the activities of his/her WP.
• Be responsible for the project governance. Define project strategy in line with contract requirements, including PMP elaboration and objectives allocation to Sub-Systems (planning, cost, quality, performance)
• Lead and coordinate project activities and stakeholders from transfer to close-out including:
• Proper transfer from tender to project
• Definition of Project objectives and main drivers (product/service performance, planning) to achieve customer satisfaction in the frame of the Contract
• Resources management: define in advance project core team staffing, as well as his/her WP resources and scalate when project resources available do not match the project needs
• Team leading, including Core Team and when applicable Project Managers of internal and external partners: make sure that key project stakeholders are aligned towards project/ goals, engage project teams in the successful achievement of project objectives and strengthen relationships among them, synchronize internal partners and arbitrate when necessary
• Alignment with contractual requirements and management of variation orders. Arbitration of Q,C,D,P re-baselining and change management at project level. Manage claim and litigations if needed
• Proactive risk, saving and opportunity management
• Management of the project progress and its KPIs, and reports to senior management, with transparency during the business/critical project reviews. He/She is the representative of the project towards Alstom management.
• Ensuring compliance with applicable rules, instructions and standards: Code of Ethics & Compliance, EHS, Railway Safety, Quality, Project Management Manual
• Manage customer and external stakeholders’ relationship: continuously ensuring alignment with customer contractual requirements, Alstom representative towards Customers and when applicable external stakeholders (Consortium, JV …) and ensuring contract management and variation orders towards customer

All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
• Degree in Engineering, Business Administration or any other relevant discipline complemented through experience by a demonstrated track record of success.
• Language skills required: advanced/business fluent level of English;
• Use of up to date IT tools such as Microsoft Office Excel, Word, PowerPoint, MS-Project.
• IPMA level C (or equivalent)
• 5 years’ experience as: sub-system/component manager or qualified project manager or manager of an operational scope
• Experience of working in and with multi-national companies and in different business cultures
• Knowledgeable of ALSTOM way of working for efficient process execution
• Project management skills
• Good communication skills
• Team management (capacity to coordinate and ensure collaboration of multi-site/multi-metier teams)
• Leadership, entrepreneurship mindset and result oriented
• Good Knowledge of Project management processes
• Knowledge of railway products and systems
• Ability to manage customer relationship
• Negotiation skills

Things you’ll enjoy

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
• Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
• Work with new security standards for rail signalling
• Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
• Contribute to innovative projects
• Utilise our cooperative working environment
• Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
• Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
• Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage.

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

An agile, inclusive and responsible culture is the foundation of our company where diverse people are offered excellent opportunities to grow, learn and advance in their careers. We are committed to encouraging our employees to reach their full potential, while valuing and respecting them as individuals

What you'll do

As a Project Manager, you will work in our Berlin or Madrid office with your team lead to develop, launch and manage your events, from A to Z. Together with the other departments, you will define the way to scale a wide range of events to all our other Nordic (Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Sweden, Finland) markets.
You will be responsible for owning the strategic planning, execution, and reporting for our key strategic experiences.

When you join Fever, you are joining a company that will invest in your professional development. You will receive training and coaching on how to:

• Work as part... of a team, pitching and closing events for big partners (Big Entertainment companies)
• Full ownership over the events/projects you are assigned to: from venue scouting, negotiations, stakeholder management to the final execution of the event
• Work with the Fever marketing team to make sure events make an impact: both in terms of ticket sales and coverage
• Manage, report on, and grow revenue from events
• P&L ownership

• Communicate product needs (Fever usability) and process needs to HQ, work with product/engineering to deliver on them
• Represent Fever at local events and with local PR

• Fluent in English and German. Nordic language is considered a plus

• You'll have strong communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships

• Curious and keen to push boundaries and try new concepts

jobs_results.description:
Job Description

The effectiveness, scope and depth of our Service and Support teams have, and will continue to be, a competitive advantage for the company. The core strategy of our customer facing teams across the company is to make it easier for our customers to do business with us. As Customer Care Service Center of Excellence (CoE) we Simplify the Customer Journey and Unlock Organizational Scale by building a Shared Entry Platform into the Thermo Fisher service organizations by aligning our operating mechanism and defining a gold standard within the company. We thrive for aligned and connected global processes, systems and teams to cater for our Divisions Customers clinical and strategic needs.

The Customer Care Service CoE plays a vital role in strengthening and enabling commercial success, shapes the global Remote Service strategy and execution; enables strategy implementation and Playbooks for process alignments across the remote teams, hand in hand with the Global Service and... Support Division leaders.

As the Senior Project Manager for Business Transformation for Customer Care Service CoE, you will be responsible to understand our customers' needs, and provide the strategic direction and guidance to define a global standard for how we deliver service and value to our customers pre-and post-sale across multiple businesses, geographies and in numerous languages worldwide.

This role is accountable for all Customer Experience Measurements and Methodology for Customer Care Service CoE.

Key responsibilities include the execution of the strategic plans for both technology and migration timeline. Deploying and aligning KPIs, performance dashboards, training, process documentation as well various projects across the globe and across the different service businesses to ensure strong and aligned service delivery of support for internal and external customers in alignment with matrixed functions.

The successful candidate will report directly to the Director of Business Transformation, Customer Care Service CoE.

Key requirements and tasks:

Execution of strategic and project vision of program: Drive execution and drive success of the program across all regions and if applicable all divisions included. Operational Excellence: Drive standardization, harmonization across service businesses to ensure accountability at all levels of the organization through data, process and metrics which will be accomplished through close partnership with IT, service functions, and business analysts. Project Management: Experience as leading successful projects through industry – recognized, best – in – class project management standards. Other projects will be assigned based on workload availability.

How will you get there?
• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in experience in Life Sciences discipline required.
• Key interpersonal savvy skills that can be used to influence key matrix partners.
• Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 25% of time.
• Proven experience, comfort and familiarity leading a large scale global heavily metrics driven organization, with the ability to understand the data and derive action plans from that data.
• Proven success in building collaborative partnerships with field teams (Service Sales, Instrument Sales, Field Management) and internal organizations (Marketing, Service Development, Regulatory & Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, Operations and facilities).
• Proven excellence in communication (verbal and written), negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
• Strong PPI approach – able to drive productivity and sustainable improvements. PMP certification preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities
• Fluency in English (verbal and written)
• Project management skills and capabilities (planning tools, defining deliverables, business case and baseline development)
• Experience in successfully leading project deliverables and working on big projects.
• Ability to work independently, within a team, and collaboratively across teams.
• Capable of handling multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
• Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills across all levels of the organization.
• Proven track record of following through on commitments.
• Good planning, organizational, and time management skills.
• Team Player, able to work effectively with others.
• Ability to deal with highly sensitive information in line with confidentiality expectations.
• Good MS Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) skills.

Working Conditions:
• Works in an office environment. Domestic and international travel may be 0 - 25%
• We are proud to be an Affirmative Action / Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse and inclusive workforce

jobs_results.description:
Job Description Summary
About the position:
Responsible for activities related to the construction, building and commissioning on customer site, from site mobilization, through civil, erection and commissioning work, as well as management activities related to this scope.

About the business:
The GE Hydro, a sub-division of GE Vernova is involved in hydroelectricity generation. This includes the design, manufacture, and installation of equipment for both gravity fed and pumped-storage power plants, and as upgrades to existing hydroelectric plants.

Job Description

PLEASE NOTE:

Applicants with European Union citizenship are encouraged to apply.

This position is required to work across Europe in different locations.

Purpose of the Job/Job Mission

Put the equipment of generator package into service under his / her responsibility according to EHS and Quality standard and respecting the given delays.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities
1. Operational
• Prepare the commissioning... activities for the concerned product / package:
• Receive the preparation package including (but not limited to), drawings, Operation and Maintenance Manual, settings notices, Safety notices, commissioning procedures and test reports, field quality working plan, general and specific risk assessment related to the commissioning works, last software version, Site organization chart and communication channel, commissioning schedule
• Set-up the necessary tools including associated calibration certificate
• Execute the commissioning activities of the designated scope of works strictly
• following the EHS rules and according to the quality standards:
• Verify the completion of the erection activities and sign the hand over certificate, define the associated punch list if required.
• Perform risk assessment and take appropriate control measures before starting any major testing & Commissioning.
• Issue or take work permit as per site PTW norms for the erection / commissioning
• activities.
• Perform the individual tests of the equipment of the designated scope
• Perform the functional tests of the equipment of the designated scope
• Perform the tests and final adjustments of the equipment during the overall tests
• Manage the non-conformity raised during the commissioning activities and reportit through the NCM database
• Issue weekly report to the Commissioning Manager and the Head Commissioning department including progress of works and forecast
• Manage the subcontractor staff if any
• Complete the commissioning activities:
• Issue the final test reports and manage to have it signed by the Client / Engineer
• Issue the red-marked drawings
• Deliver training to the Client personnel if required
• Manage to have a minimalist punch list (issue an internal punch list if necessary)
• Provide feedback of experience to the Head of commissioning department.

2. Managerial (Budget / Administration / People)
• Achieving all Commissioning milestones within the site schedule
• Maintaining customer relationship and a high level of customer satisfaction.
• Representation of GE Hydro in front of the customer Engineers.
• Always maintaining and enhancing the professional image and reputation of GE Hydro.

3. Functional/transverse (optional)
• Responsible to give/ share feedback of experience to H.O (Head of Commissioning)
• Ear mark or convey if any deviation noticed at site equipment/ work as per standards followed.

Specific Functional/Technical authority (besides DoA):
• Is authorized to take urgent or emergency action to remedy sudden problems or discrepancies.

Measurement / Key Performance Indicators
• System wise or package wise major milestones achieved on time.
• Package wise site Commissioning targets are achieved.
• Machines are performing well with desired parameters for concern package.
• All the contractual requirements and tests are met for designated package
• All the punch points are closed for designated package
• EHS Road Map targets are achieved with zero lost time injuries or fatalities.
• Customer satisfaction survey targets are achieved.
• All required performance assessments are completed.
• All the protocols/ final data/ settings communicated to HO (Commissioning head)
• Red marked drawings for designated package are updated and submitted to HO (Commissioning head)
• All the feedbacks are furnished to HO (Commissioning head)

Required Qualifications
• Knowledge level is comparable to a Bachelor's degree from an accredited university/college or a high school diploma with relevant experience.
• Experience in the Project Management & Installation & Construction.
• Experience with Hydro turbines/generators is preferred.
• Professional working English language skills (written & verbal).
• Good interpersonal and leadership skills.
• Basic understanding of key business drivers.
• Good understanding of how work of own team integrates with other teams and contributes to the area.

What Do We Offer?
• Career growth opportunity
• Professional and personal development trainings
• Enthusiastic team with supportive leaders
• Multicultural and diverse environment
• A pleasant and modern work infrastructure
• Competitive salary with benefits (including medical insurance as well)

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No
